extracted.name: Pink gin spritz
extracted.description: Pair fruity pink gin with lychee liqueur to make this refreshing spritz cocktail. It's beautifully delicate and floral – ideal for an al fresco gathering.
instruction_lines: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour over the gin and lychee liqueur, then top up with sparkling water.
